name: 15144 · Springdale, PA
findings: ZIP 15144 (Springdale) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15144 (Springdale) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
